title: How should I handle the failing payment-webhook tests?

elements.markdown: **Context:** 4 tests in `webhook_handler_test` fail after the Stripe API version bump. The mock fixtures predate the new event schema. I can patch the fixtures or regenerate them from live sandbox events.

options.description: ~20 min. Keeps current test structure, but fixtures drift further from real payloads.
~1 hour. Fixtures match production exactly; needs sandbox API keys.
